newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Nov soybeans fall further, contract low hit.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Nov soybeans fall further, contract low hit.

text.p: CBOT November soybean futures fell further on Monday and a new contract low was notched in reaction to USDA's 1997 U.S. soybean acreage forecast, traders said.
Contract lows were also notched in the September, January, March, May and July contracts.
The bearish momentum was sparked by Monday's USDA acreage report which projected 1997 U.S. acres planted to soybeans at 70.85 million, above trade expectations.
Pit sources said sell stops were hit in the November near the previous contract low of $5.97-1/2 a bushel. The November traded as low as $5.91 a bushel before rebounding slightly.
At 1043 CDT, soybeans were down 21-1/4 to six cents per bushel with November down 21 at $5.96-1/2 a bushel and July down six at $7.65.
